customer_john: Hey @support, after the model swap this morning our ingestion pipeline started failing — JSON outputs are malformed and our parser errors out. High priority, hitting prod batch jobs. Example response and request id below, started ~09:04 UTC.

emma_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact response you got and the request id? Also which model are you calling (model name + version)?

customer_john: Request id `req_8a3f2c`. Calling `redwood-qa-v2.1` (the one that went live at ~18:05 UTC). Here's the raw output we received: 
```
{"status":"ok","items":[{"id":1,"name":"foo",},],}
```
That trailing comma makes our parser explode. This used to be strict JSON with no trailing commas on v2.0.

emma_support: Thanks — that definitely looks like an extra trailing comma. I'm going to ping eng and check deployment logs.

emma_support: @deploy-bot can you confirm recent model rollouts?

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: model `redwood-qa-v2.1` rolled to production at 2026-03-12T18:05:12Z by `maddie_prod`. Release notes: compact-output flag enabled by default for shorter footprints.

emma_support: Looks related — the release notes mention `compact-output`. @raj_engineering can you take a look?

raj_engineering: On it. Can you include the exact API call you made (headers + body)? Also, did you set `json_mode:true` or pass a `json_schema`?

customer_john: API call (trimmed): 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer XXX
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-qa-v2.1",
  "json_schema": {"type":"object","required":["status","items"],"properties":{"status":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array"}}},
  "input": "Generate inventory list for order 345"
}
```
We relied on strict key names. No special flags other than `json_schema` and `max_tokens`.

raj_engineering: Thanks. Reproducing locally now. Quick theory: the new compact-output optimization may be post-processing tokens and occasionally emits a truncated/compact JSON with dangling commas when short-circuiting — a bug. Short-term workaround: pin to `redwood-qa-v2.0` (previous version) or disable compacting via params if available.

emma_support: To pin model version (temporary): 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pins 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
 -d '{"target_model":"redwood-qa-v2.0","scope":"org"}'
```
That should route your calls to v2.0 until we fix v2.1.

izzy_sre: Also checking infra — saw a kernel optimization flip on some hosts that changed token batching behavior. If the runtime short-circuits output assembly it could produce malformed JSON in edge cases. I'll check which nodes served `req_8a3f2c`.

customer_john: I pinned to v2.0 and some jobs recovered, but a few still returned responses missing the `status` key entirely (schema drift). Example: 
```
{"items":[{"id":1,"name":"foo"}]}
```
So the model sometimes drops keys rather than just trailing commas.

raj_engineering: Dropping keys is consistent with a compacting step that prunes fields considered redundant. That's a regression for structured-output mode. Can you upload a few more failing payloads and the full HTTP response headers (we need the `X-Model-Version` header to trace which worker served it)?

customer_john: Uploaded logs to the support portal (ticket 6538) and included full headers. I see `X-Model-Version: redwood-qa-v2.1+sha:8f3b`.

maddie_prod: Noted. We enabled `compact-output` by default to reduce token costs in 2.1, but it shouldn't modify required schema fields. This is a release regression. I'll coordinate an immediate mitigation — either flip the flag off globally or roll v2.1 back.

deploy-bot: Rollback command queued: initiating rollback of `redwood-qa-v2.1` to `redwood-qa-v2.0` for production cluster.

raj_engineering: We're adding a guard that forces `json_schema` required fields to be preserved even when compacting. Will push a hotfix and a stricter parser in the post-processing step. ETA 2-3 hours.

emma_support: For customers: recommend pin to v2.0 or set `compact_output:false` if your SDK supports it. We're classifying this as P1 for structured-output customers.

customer_john: Thanks — pin + rollback helped. Parser is green on most batches. Appreciate the quick response.

raj_engineering: Appreciate the detailed repro examples. If you see any further drift after rollback, please ping this thread and attach request ids.

customer_john: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
